description:
Record and manage GPX tracks on an offline map, with no internet permission

Record and manage rides, runs and hikes on an offline map, with no internet permission at all. Tracks are standard GPX files, and maps are optional Mapsforge files you import yourself.

Features

  • Record tracks in the background with pausing, waypoints and live charts
  • Recordings survive most crashes
  • Speed and elevation charts by distance or time, with zoom
  • Import and export .gpx tracks compatible with other apps
  • Trim, search, sort and categorize tracks
  • Show, hide, export or delete many tracks at once
  • Maps are optional; without one, tracks draw on a blank background
  • All maps share one canvas and don't need to be adjacent

Non-features

  • Anything requiring internet access
  • External device integration
  • Map routing or searching

Android's cloud backup is disabled; only device-to-device transfers are allowed, which some backup apps such as Seedvault can also use. Recording needs system location on, so Android itself or other apps may still collect location data.
